title: ExPert infers likely causal perturbations from cell states
summary: ExPert learns one prototype per perturbation in a latent space shared by 12 cellular contexts, trained on 8,964 perturbations and 19.5 million cells, and ranks 19,895 candidate genes per query. It more than doubled held-out-context recall over the best existing method with 1,000-fold less compute, and in alcohol-associated liver disease it implicated mRNA export, with nuclear poly(A) retention and isoform switching experimentally confirmed. Experiment sizes and held-out numbers were not read.
ai_technology: ExPert latent-prototype model ranking gene perturbations from observed cell states
organization: Northwestern University; Robert H. Lurie Comprehensive Cancer Center of Northwestern University; Technical University of Munich

evidence.tested: Held-out context evaluation and wet-lab confirmation of the alcohol-associated liver disease prediction.
